loze / is Later Than Period

is Later Than Period

Property

The relation that obtains between a period of time p and another period of time p' if and only if p is entirely posterior to p' along the temporal axis

https://loze-ontology.org/isLaterThanPeriod

For example

The year 2008 is later than 1972, the early-modern period is later than classical antiquity, the XVI century is later than the XIII century

Specialisation

Asserting a sub-property asserts its own domain and range, not just the parent's. Anything you put either side is taken to be of the narrower class, whether or not you said so.

isLaterThanPeriodPeriod Of Time → Period Of Time
isSubsequentPeriodToPeriod Of Time → Period Of Time
Note

This relation does not obtain in those cases in which one period is only partly posterior to another one - for example, it does not obtain between the 1800-1850 period and the 1815-1870 period

loze is a top-level ontology after E. J. Lowe's four-category ontology, with Zemach's schematic particulars. Every term here is identified by an IRI under https://loze-ontology.org/.
